_comment_profile: OPUS-ONLY PROFILE, the fleet default. The 1M window is explicit via the [1m] suffix on `model`. Do NOT add CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT here: that is the flag that drops the window back to 200K. The highest effortLevel a settings FILE accepts is 'xhigh' — writing 'max' here silently does nothing; use /effort max for a single session.

permissions._comment: This repository holds documentation, shell hooks and templates — no application, no database, no secret. The allow-list is therefore reading, writing and git; nothing builds here. GRANTING A NEW PERMISSION IS THE OWNER'S ACT: it gets written into this file together with its reason and how to revert it, never applied silently. THE DENY-LIST ALWAYS BEATS THE ALLOW-LIST.
